notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level), gate runs used: 3 (the third after an edit of facts.md). The card is a driver pack; this package covers one of its five entry symbols, the A2D electronic load (lab_equipment.Eload_A2D_Eload:A2D_Eload), and NOT COVERED: the other four entry symbols, A2D_DAQ (A2D_DAQ_control.py:10), SPD1000 (PSU_SPD1000.py:13), Arduino_IO (OTHER_Arduino_IO_Module.py:10) and A2D_POWER_BOARD (SMU_A2D_POWER_BOARD.py:7), each named in facts.md. NOT COVERED inside the load: only channel 1 of the RS485 bus is used (the class allows up to 32 loads on the bus, Eload_A2D_Eload.py:9; the driver neither selects another channel nor reads or writes the RS485 address), and the calibration commands and reads (CAL:V, CAL:I), INSTR:KICK and the CURR:CTRL readback are not exposed. The target current read by CURR? is exposed as the read-only field current_reported with the load's own negative sign: the clone multiplies the reply by -1 to obtain the positive setpoint (Eload_A2D_Eload.py:74-75), and the SCPI bridge cannot negate a read, so a write of current = 2 A leaves current_reported = -2 A; the write itself sends the positive magnitude, as the clone does. The mock path is a fake of the wire protocol (write/read/query), not the upstream Fake_Eload of Eload_Fake.py:4, which stands in for the class's Python methods rather than a transport; the identity reply of the fake is a placeholder and the driver checks no identity pattern because the clone prints no exact *IDN? string. The hardware backend (a pyvisa/RS485 connection) never ran and no instrument was attached, so the wire syntax of the driver is untried on hardware. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-10-29; reviewed_by stays null): accepted; the reviewer changed no file of the package. After the registry rebuild refreshed task.json, the reviewer re-ran the gate and wrote its digest above.
